name: Yamaha Raider / Stryker
engine: 1854 cc air-cooled V-twin (Raider) or 1304 cc liquid-cooled V-twin (Stryker), fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Yamaha's factory choppers. The Raider uses the big 1900 air-cooled twin, the Stryker the liquid-cooled 1300.

H: The Raider is air-cooled and has no radiator. Skip the coolant steps on a Raider.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
